name: Hongji Agriculture — Potato Flakes & Powder Technical Specifications
alternateName: 弘基农业土豆雪花粉与土豆粉技术规格数据集
description: Machine-readable technical specifications for Hongji potato flakes and potato powder (60 mesh): moisture, ash, reducing sugars, starch, protein, bulk density, particle size, rehydration ratio, colour, contaminant and microbiological limits, packaging and MOQ.

creator.name: Zhangjiakou Hongji Agriculture Technology Development Co., Ltd.

publisher.name: Zhangjiakou Hongji Agriculture Technology Development Co., Ltd.

notes: Values are the guaranteed specifications declared in the controlling product specification (HJ-TD-PE-03-PK/1-01-D-2025) and the technical datasheets. Typical and process-target values are labelled with "value_type". Microbiological limits for individual orders may be agreed more strictly; confirm against the specification version in force for your order.
